content.p: Let T:\mathbb R^{{n}}\to\mathbb R^{{m}} be the linear transformation given by T\left({{varvector}}\right)={{varmap}}. One of the following sets is a basis for the kernel of T, and the other is a basis for the image of T. A={{S1}}\hspace{2em}B={{S2}}
Which of the following correctly verifies the rank-nullity theorem for T?

outtro.p: \operatorname{rank} T={{rank}} and \operatorname{nullity} T={{nullity}}. Thus \operatorname{rank} T+\operatorname{nullity} T={{rank}}+{{nullity}}={{n}}{{#equal}}={{/equal}}{{^equal}}\neq {{m}}={{/equal}}\dim\left(\mathbb R^{ {{dim}} }\right).
